outcome: intensity of inflammatory mediators (interleukin (IL)-1b, IL-6, IL-8, IL-10, tumor necrosis factor-a, matrix metalloproteins (MMP)-8, MMP-9) in amniotic fluid
cohort: The study included 153 cases of singleton preterm birth at 24-34 weeks' gestation, who underwent cesarean delivery.
finding: Cervical Ureaplasma spp. colonization did not significantly affect the intensity of inflammatory mediators in the amniotic fluid retrieved during cesarean delivery, regardless of the presence of Histologic chorioamnionitis.
cross-section timing: During cesarean delivery for preterm birth
